old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-2502","title":"lichend treats identity/epoch storage errors and malformed records as first boot","description":"P1 security review. Startup uses load_seed(\u0026storage).ok().flatten() and load_epoch(\u0026storage).ok().flatten().unwrap_or(128). Any read/I/O error is discarded; malformed-length records also map to None. Seed failure generates and writes a new identity before later mismatch exit, while epoch failure resets/persists 128. This contradicts fail-closed comments, destroys recovery evidence, and permits replay-state rollback. Distinguish Missing from Corrupt/Unavailable, create state only on confirmed missing first boot, never overwrite failed existing records, and test I/O errors, short/long records, corruption, and rollback.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:23:43.989998Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:23:43.989998Z"}
